title: Minimax Estimation of Counterfactual Entropy under Vanishing Propensity and Density Zeros
banked_reason: Supervisor-directed capped stop: exact frontier open for q > s, 0 <= kappa < q/s after three solve rounds and two distinct constructions; preserve the c a_n to C a_n Lambda_n^2 bracket and exact complementary regimes as discovery partial results, without declaring the kernel false.
gap_reasons: The residual Lambda_n^2 question is a genuine research barrier for this D0 run.
These are proof-route obstructions, not all-procedure lower bounds.
proof_attempt_summary: Three solve rounds and two distinct construction directives produced the discovery bracket c a_n <= R_n,C_n <= C a_n Lambda_n^2, with alpha=s/(s+q), a_n=n^(-alpha)(log n)^(alpha-2), and Lambda_n=log(e+log n), same-n constant risk/length comparison, and exact complementary regimes. A logarithmic-degree raw-L2 lift failed on a legal variance witness; pilot-banded truncated-L1 and local clipping encountered high-order-majorant and clipping-bias obstructions. These are method-specific obstructions, not minimax impossibility: the exact frontier remains open for q>s and 0<=kappa<q/s; D0.5 novelty review and Lean formalization did not run, and the supervisor explicitly directed a capped stop.
tldr: The target is marginal causal entropy on a fixed outcome scale, under known vanishing treatment propensity, exact outcome-density zeros, and arbitrary measurable covariate association. Total original-record procedures give minimax absolute-risk and finite-sample honest connected-interval bounds. With \(\alpha=s/(s+q)\), both criteria lie between constant multiples of \(\max\{n^{-\alpha}(\log n)^{\alpha-2},\rho_\kappa(n)\}\) and \(\max\{n^{-\alpha}(\log n)^{\alpha-2}\{\log(\mathrm e+\log n)\}^2,\rho_\kappa(n)\}\). They are comparable at the same sample size in every regime, and have exact order \(\rho_\kappa(n)\) whenever \(q=s=1\) or \(\kappa\ge q/s\). The only remaining exact-rate gap is the iterated-logarithm factor in the strict regime. The new pilot-banded audit exposes all-order and cellwise-clipping failures of a proposed certificate; it does not settle that gap.
gap: Clean zero-allowed entropy results and regular counterfactual-functional inference do not settle entropy of an arbitrarily associated marginal mixture observed through a vanishing known propensity.
fill: A single matched original-record theorem must combine observable nonlinear attainment with legal normalized all-procedure lower experiments and uniformly honest connected intervals.
